expectations.text: Cuts the starting channel list to what two part-time staff can fill
expectations.evidence: The transcript replaces the 12 per-SDK channels with one `#help` forum that uses 12 SDK tags. It gives the reason directly: '12 empty rooms on day 1, with 2 part-time people to watch them.' It also defers `#jobs` and `#memes`, leaving 7 public and 2 private channels. Each deferred channel gets a trigger for adding it later: an SDK tag reaching 5+ threads a week for 3 weeks, about 200 active members for `#jobs`, and `#off-topic` filling with memes for `#memes`.
